items.parking_description: The Royal Sands offers self parking and valet parking. Valet parking is included in the all-inclusive package. There are two parking lots, one in front of the resort with 233 parking spaces and a second one to the north of the Garden lobby with 82 spaces.
items.description: Located on Cancun’s finest beach, The Royal Sands ® by Holiday Inn Club Vacations® has breathtaking views of white sand and shimmering turquoise waters. Enjoy an unforgettable all-inclusive vacation at this 340-suite resort with a wealth of resort amenities, activities and dining options. Spacious, fully equipped suites, all with ocean views, exceptional service and hallmark hospitality make it the perfect spot for a Cancun vacation with the family or friends. Relax and recharge on the beach or by the pool – there are three to choose from, find your favorite daily activities, sports and classes. Children will love the kids club, the children’s playground and the kiddie pool. The resort also has an Aqua Park for families to enjoy. Add some spa pampering to your vacation with a morning at Alea® Spa and a massage, body wrap or facial to soothe body and soul. A gym and a beauty salon are also onsite. The dining scene is varied with plenty of choices for everyone in the family and cuisine ranging from International, Continental and Mexican to pizzas, sushi and U.S.-style burgers and wings at the sports bar. A convenience store with a coffee shop, a boutique, travel agency for day trips, water sports, car rentals and airport transportation, are some of the many services this resort offers.

items.name: Coral Cancún
items.address: Boulevard Kukulcan km. 17, Cancun, ROO 77500, MX
items.description: Welcome to Iberostar Selection Coral Cancún, an exquisite haven of tranquility and indulgence, where the allure of Mexico's breathtaking landscape meets the sophisticated allure of modern design and luxurious living. Nestled along the sun-kissed shores of this tropical paradise, our adults-only resort beckons you to embark on an unforgettable journey of relaxation and opulence. With a dedication to providing an exclusive experience, we have crafted a sanctuary where every detail, from the architecture to the amenities, embodies elegance and sophistication. Join us in discovering a world where serenity meets style, where your well-being is our top priority, and where your escape from the ordinary begins.

items.name: Cancún
items.address: Boulevard Kukulcan km. 17, Cancun, ROO 77500, MX
items.description: When it comes to ideal locations, Iberostar Selection Cancun is the total trifecta. Not only is it situated only 15km from the airport, but it’s also located in the heart of Cancun with convenient access anywhere you want to go yet boasts a breathtaking ocean view on the other side that will make you forget all about the rest of the world. The energetic atmosphere charms guests of all ages with an impossibly blue infinity pool, a waterpark for the kids at heart of any age, and an oceanfront palapa to indulge in a seaside massage. There’s also an 18-hole golf course featuring breathtaking views, and a food truck serving up snacks all afternoon. You really get the best of both worlds, from full cultural immersion in Cancun to absolute solitude and relaxation within the walls of the resort. The choice is yours and every way is a win.

items.name: Presidente Cancun Resort
items.address: BLVD KUKULKAN KM 7.5, CANCUN, ROO 77500, MX
items.pet_policy: Max of 2 pets are allowed in each bedroom. Pets are not allowed in any restaurant or consumption center. When moving through public areas of the hotel Lobby the pet must always carry a leash. Pet Deposit does not include taxes.
items.parking_description: Parking is free for all guests, subject to availability, and it includes electric vehicle charging.
items.description: Surrounded by white sand and crystal-clear Caribbean waters, InterContinental Presidente Cancun Resort is a five-star luxury resort located on the best beach in Cancun. Enjoy breathtaking views of the water, five dining and beverage venues, a kid’s club for children, and convenient location close to Cancun’s vibrant nightlife. Unwind with a spa treatment, or simply relax in your room and enjoy the tranquility of the calming sea.

items.name: The Royal Cancun All Inclusive
items.address: Km. 4.5., Blvd. Kukulcan, Cancun, ROO 77500, MX
items.pet_policy: No animals are permitted on the premises, except for service animals individually trained to assist a person with a disability. Guests must notify the resort at least five days prior to arrival and provide current official certification documentation.
items.description: Located on the north shore of Cancun, The Royal Cancun® by Holiday Inn Club Vacations is the perfect spot for a fun-filled family vacation or a relaxing getaway to revel in the beauty of the Mexican Caribbean. Nestled on a sheltered beach with calm, clear waters that children will love, this all-inclusive resort is set in lush tropical gardens and offers two-bedroom villas equipped with everything guests need for a great stay. Enjoy stunning views of Cancun's famous turquoise waters, of the resort pools or gardens from your own private balcony as you sip a cocktail and catch up on your vacation reading. Ready for some fun? There are daily activities for all ages, a kids club, two pools and a kiddie pool, tennis courts, a multi-sports court, and a fitness center at the resort. Enjoy sailing, snorkeling, and paddle boarding, and there is even a kayak tour through the lagoon. After a morning on the water, a beach massage is a blissful way to spend the afternoon. Dine on fresh seafood, International fare, Mexican dishes, and Italian cuisine at the resort's two restaurants. For casual in-villa dining, check the room service menu or order a pizza from the in-house delivery service. The Royal Cancun also has a minimarket, a villa spa for massages, facials, and manicures, and a travel agency for tours, water sports, and car rentals.

items.name: Riviera Cancun
items.address: Bahia Petempich, Puerto Morelos, ROO 77580, MX
items.description: Discover Iberostar Selection Riviera Cancún, located just 20 minutes from the airport and very close to the fishing village of Puerto Morelos—the perfect hotel for you to unwind as a couple or with your family. You can enjoy 5 pools, spacious suites—including swim-up categories with direct access to a semi-private pool—and a varied, health-conscious dining experience across 6 restaurants and 4 bars. Explore the ocean, try water sports, relax with a massage, or play a game of tennis. Meanwhile, the little ones will have a blast at our Star Camp—a program packed with activities tailored to different age groups. And all of this, with a commitment to respecting and caring for the oceans.

items.name: Grand Residences All Inclusive
items.address: Blvd. El Cid 28 y 29, Puerto Morelos, ROO 77580, MX
items.pet_policy: No animals are permitted on the premises, except for service animals individually trained to assist a person with a disability. Guests must notify the resort at least five days prior to arrival and provide current official certification documentation.
items.description: Grand Residences by Royal Resorts® is an exclusive resort hideaway on a spectacular white-sand beach to the south of the picturesque fishing village of Puerto Morelos in the Mexican Caribbean. It offers 144 luxury ocean view suites that are a sanctuary for relaxation, a wealth of resort amenities and activities, gourmet cuisine, hallmark hospitality, touches of refinement and attention to detail to make each vacation moment one to treasure. The all-inclusive package includes accommodation, daily activities, delightful dining and more. The resort architecture takes its inspiration from grand old Mexican haciendas or estate houses. Stone columns, arches, terraces with fountains and splendid beach views at every turn make it a romantic spot for a wedding in paradise.

items.name: Paraíso del Mar
items.address: Carretera Chetumal - P. Juarez Km 309, Riviera Maya, ROO 77710, MX
items.description: Imagine landing in a place where every sight is a feast for your eyes. Surrounded by gardens galore. Three pools beyond a long stretch of beach. A shopping center you don’t have to leave the resort for. And Balinese beds wrapped in gorgeous Bougainvillea to laze the days away in, on a quiet, pool surrounded island. And that’s just the tip of the Paraiso del Mar iceberg.

items.name: Paraíso Beach
items.address: Carretera Chetumal - P. Juarez Km 309, Riviera Maya, ROO 77710, MX
items.description: When the resort grounds are as stunning as the beach it sits on, the hardest decision you will have to make is where to spend your day. There’s entertainment for everyone in the family. Every day. A shopping center on the property. And three shimmering pools to take your pick from. It’s where every moment is an opportunity to explore life in paradise. Without limits.

items.name: Paraíso Maya Suites
items.address: Carretera Chetumal Puerto Juárez Km.309,, Riviera Maya, ROO 77710, MX
items.description: At Iberostar Selection Paraíso Maya Suites every member of the family can live the life of luxury. Think water park. An elaborate shopping center. Beachfront access. A golf course, a spa, and all day treats at the Star Café. With a relaxing suite to retreat to at the end of the day.

items.name: Paraíso Lindo
items.address: Carretera Chetumal Puerto Juárez Km.309,, Riviera Maya, ROO 77710, MX
items.description: Iberostar Selection Paraíso Lindo is the place to go when you want a quaint feel on a grand scale. Centrally located in the heart of the Paraiso complex, with instant access to everything this resort has to offer, and proximity to your own personal retreat, it's the equivalent of having your cake and eating it too!

items.name: Paraíso by Iberostar
items.address: Carretera Chetumal - P. Juarez Km 309, Riviera Maya, ROO 77710, MX
items.description: Welcome to JOIA Paraíso by Iberostar, an award-winning 5-star oasis on the Riviera Maya where every moment invites relaxation and connection. This adults-only, all-suite, all-inclusive retreat offers personalized butler service and is nestled within a private gated complex shared with four other premium Iberostar hotels - perfect for a luxurious escape on the white-sand shores of Playa Paraíso. Let us take care of the details while you soak up the simplicity of paradise. From spa sessions and gourmet dining to golf, diving, and beachside relaxation, JOIA Paraíso by Iberostar offers a luxurious escape packed with activities, upscale amenities, and personalized service.

items.name: Tres Rios - All Inclusive
items.address: Carretera Cancun-Tulum, Km. 54.5, Playa del Carmen, ROO 77760, MX
badges: Hosted Evening Wine Hour for all Kimpton Guests
items.pet_policy: Pets are welcome but best left at home due to the environment of the resort.
items.parking_description: Offers guest convenient parking options at no additional cost. The property provides free on - site parking , including spaces off the main road,ideal for travelers arriving by car
items.description: Some resorts give you a beach. Kimpton Tres Rios – All Inclusive gives you a whole world. Tucked along the Riviera Maya between Cancun and Playa del Carmen, this all-inclusive resort sits inside a 340-acre nature preserve of rivers, cenotes, mangroves, and eco-trails that wind right through the property. Sun loungers and swaying palms are just the beginning. Every suite blends into the lush surroundings with natural textures, contemporary styling, private balconies, and sweeping views of the Caribbean Sea or protected mangrove landscape. Seven distinct restaurants and five bars mean dinner is never the same twice, whether you're settling into a mezcal cocktail at Sabina, discovering Asian fusion at Kotori, or pulling up a stool at the Nebbia rooftop bar as the sun goes down. The Kej Spa anchors the resort's wellness approach with hydrotherapy, temazcal ceremonies, and restorative treatments, while Club Aventuras keeps younger guests engaged with daily programming and outdoor adventures. Pets are always welcome at no extra charge, and the Kimpton team brings their signature heartfelt service to every interaction, making the all-inclusive experience feel genuinely personal rather than packaged. Whether you're kayaking through the mangroves, relaxing beside an adults-only pool, or joining a morning yoga session on the beach, Kimpton Tres Rios – All Inclusive is built for travelers who want it all without sacrificing what makes a place feel real.

items.name: Royal Haciendas All Inclusive
items.address: Km. 289+10, Carr. Cancun-Tulum, Playa del Carmen, ROO 77710, MX
items.pet_policy: No animals are permitted on the premises, except for service animals individually trained to assist a person with a disability. Guests must notify the resort at least five days prior to arrival and provide current official certification documentation.
items.description: Offering elegance in a splendid natural setting, and inspired by the grand estates of the Yucatan. The Royal Haciendas® by Holiday Inn Club Vacations® is nestled on the shores of a sheltered bay that is perfect for snorkeling and swimming, it is a ten-minute drive from Playa del Carmen, at the heart of the Riviera Maya, and just 30 minutes from Cancun International Airport. Just steps from the beach, the spacious suites have everything you need to relax during your vacation, including private balconies. The resort has extensive pool areas and gardens, sports and activities, restaurants, bars, a diving center and a tour desk for sightseeing trips. Or you can relax in true Riviera Maya style with a massage at the Spa before slipping into a hammock and letting the warm sun and gentle breeze do the rest.

items.name: Playa del Carmen
items.address: 1A. Avenida Norte #300, Playa del Carmen, ROO 77720, MX
items.pet_policy: We welcome one pet per room. A nightly pet fee of 500 MXN applies, plus a refundable deposit of 5,000 MXN. If you are traveling with a service animal, contact us by email or phone before your arrival.
items.parking_description: Guests can access the underground garage or, if full, a nearby lot. Our team ensures a smooth arrival so you can focus on enjoying your stay.
items.description: Welcome to Hotel Indigo Playa del Carmen, located just steps from the Caribbean Sea and the lively Quinta Avenida. Our boutique hotel places you in the heart of Playa’s vibrant neighborhood, surrounded by shops, cafés, and nightlife. Discover nearby attractions like Tulum’s ancient ruins, Coba’s jungle pyramids, and eco-parks such as Xcaret and Xel-Há. Swim in crystal-clear cenotes, snorkel with sea turtles, or stroll along the Riviera Maya’s white-sand beaches. Relax in rooms with plush bedding, sleek bathrooms, free WiFi, and mini fridges. Many feature private terraces or ocean views. Unwind at our rooftop pool and lounge, the perfect spot for panoramic sunsets or private gatherings.

items.name: Playa del Carmen
items.address: Avenida Constituyentes entre 10 y 15 nte. S/N, Playa del Carmen, ROO 77720, MX
items.street: Avenida Constituyentes entre 10 y 15 nte. S/N
items.pet_policy: Only service dogs are allowed with formal documentation; doctor prescription and service dog certificate. Emotional dogs have a fee per night 1000 mxn, Pet deposit in cash per stay  will be refunded at check out if there are no damages
items.description: Central. Comfortable. Convenient. Welcome to the smart, stylish, and well-located Holiday Inn Express and Suites Playa del Carmen, your perfect base for business, family fun, or a romantic getaway. Just one block from the iconic Quinta Avenida and a short stroll to the powdery white sand beaches of the Caribbean, the hotel offers effortless access to shopping at Quinta Alegría Mall, buzzing nightlife, and major archaeological sites like Tulum and Coba. Nature lovers will be captivated by the nearby cenotes, natural freshwater pools hidden in the jungle, perfect for a refreshing swim or a snorkeling adventure. Whether you're sunbathing on the shore or exploring local gems, the region offers unforgettable experiences. Choose from comfortable standard rooms or spacious suites, each featuring a mini fridge, microwave, and thoughtful touches for a restful stay. Start your mornings with a complimentary Express Start breakfast featuring fresh fruit, pastries, and more. Unwind on the rooftop pool with sun loungers and ocean views or work out in the rooftop gym. Free high-speed Wi-Fi, a 24-hour Business Center, and a flexible meeting room for up to 100 guests complete the experience.

items.name: Quetzal
items.address: Av Xaman-Ha. Lote hotelero Nro 2, Playa del Carmen, ROO 77710, MX
items.description: Welcome to Iberostar Waves Quetzal, where nature takes center stage. Cradled within a pristine beach and verdant natural sanctuary, our resort seamlessly blends the allure of a sun-kissed shore with a jungle oasis woven through its very core. Step into a safe world within our complex where palm-fringed paradise and lush greenery converge, offering a unique retreat that marries the best of both worlds. Immerse yourself in the soothing symphony of waves crashing against the shore and the vibrant melodies of the jungle, as our hotel invites you to a full-sensory experience, delivering the ultimate connection to nature.

items.name: Tucán
items.address: Av Xaman-Ha. Lote hotelero Fracc. Playacar Nro 2, Playa del Carmen, ROO 77710, MX
items.street: Av Xaman-Ha. Lote hotelero Fracc. Playacar Nro 2
items.description: Nestled along the pristine Playacar beachfront, and eveloped in a safe and secure complex, Iberostar Waves Tucán beckons with a lush, verdant embrace, seamlessly blending the sun-kissed sands with a captivating jungle oasis. This idyllic retreat is not merely a destination; it's an immersive haven that caters to both couples seeking a romantic escape and families yearning for unforgettable adventures. Remote enough to offer tranquility, yet intricately connected to the vibrant pulse of the surrounding city and rich cultural tapestry, it really is the best of both worlds.

items.name: Presidente Cozumel Resort Spa
items.address: KM 6.5 CARRETERA A CHANKANAAB, COZUMEL, ROO 77600, MX
badges: Free Internet for All IHG® Rewards Club Members
items.pet_policy: Up to 2 small pets 30 kg max per room are allowed with a charge of 60 USD each. They must be supervised at all times and not access common areas. Exempt from charge: guide or assistance dogs with documentation.
items.description: Enjoy an oasis of tranquility overlooking the white sands and crystal-clear, sargassum-free waters of Cozumel. Take in panoramic views of the Caribbean from the comfort of your room. Explore the island's beautiful coral reefs and marine life at our on-site dive center or unwind at our spa. If you're traveling with your family, enjoy everything this five-star resort has to offer while your children are entertained by our professional staff. We are pet-friendly.

items.name: Cozumel
items.address: Carretera Costera Sur Km 17782, San Miguel de Cozumel, ROO 77600, MX
items.description: Iberostar Waves Cozumel is a diver’s delight. Perched at the far end of the island, guests can take advantage of the picturesque and unobstructed views, calm waters, and incredible proximity to the reefs. The Caribbean village atmosphere, palm tree swing, and well-oiled dive center are just a taste of what keeps our guests coming back for more.

items.name: Tulum
items.address: Av. Coba S/N, Tulum, ROO 77760, MX
items.pet_policy: Upon check in, you must present a Pet ID Card. For guide or assistance dogs, please provide the certification document verifying that the animal is an assistance pet. Once tihis documation is presented the Pet Desposit per Stay  will not be requiered.
items.parking_description: Our underground parking facility offers 120 secure spaces, providing convenient and sheltered parking for our guests. Designed for ease and safety, it ensures your vehicle is protected while you enjoy all the amenities of Holiday Inn Tulum.
items.description: Welcome to the Holiday Inn Tulum! We're located in the heart of Tulum, in a beautiful area full of shops and other amenities. We're just 2.5 km from the Tulum Archaeological zone, and only 10 minutes bike ride from the main tourist area and beaches. We're proud to offer warm and welcoming experience, and we're here to make your leisure and business travel the best it can be. Our beautiful hotel is the perfect place to unwind, and our friendly staff are always ready to help. You can walk to the center, where you can explore the different white sand beaches, lagoons, cenotes and caverns that show the beauty of Tulum's nature in all its splendor. Our lobby has a lounge area where you can relax after a busy day, and our reception staff are always ready to assist you. Take time to relax by the beautiful pool and enjoy a drink at our pool bar. You can also make the most of our meeting room to host events. And when you're ready to unwind, our comfortable and spacious rooms will make you feel right at home.
